presets.name: Illustration (HiDream)
presets.prompt: A detailed digital illustration with clean confident linework, rich harmonious colors, soft painterly shading and a clear focal point.

presets.name: Concept Art (HiDream)
presets.prompt: Epic concept art matte painting: dramatic scale, atmospheric depth, cinematic lighting, painterly detail, professional production design.

presets.name: Oil Painting (HiDream)
presets.prompt: A classical oil painting on canvas with visible expressive brushstrokes, warm glazes, rich texture and museum-quality composition.

presets.name: Watercolor (HiDream)
presets.prompt: A delicate watercolor painting with soft washes, granulating pigment, loose edges and white paper showing through.

presets.name: Poster with Text (HiDream)
presets.prompt: A bold graphic poster with a strong layout, large clean readable typography exactly as quoted, striking colors and balanced composition.

presets.name: Product Shot (HiDream)
presets.prompt: A professional studio product photograph: the product centered on a clean surface, soft diffused lighting, crisp reflections, commercial look.

presets.name: Storybook (HiDream)
presets.prompt: A whimsical storybook illustration for a children's book: warm gentle colors, soft textures, charming characters, cozy magical atmosphere.

presets.name: Anime Art (HiDream)
presets.prompt: High-quality anime key visual: expressive characters, clean cel shading, vibrant colors, detailed background, dynamic composition.
